title: MiteEnchantDivine
description: A MITE mod that directly displays the Enchantment Table's Enchanted properties
body:
## What are the benefits of installing this mod ?
You no longer have to waste a lot of experience in order not to get the desired attributes.
### **EN**

![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c0aea7dbe52f9e6d26a9071f0e25aeb4007609f.png)

### **中文**

![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58f74f0d5b1c511bb7223ce425f891e124d2e98e.png)
## Notice & BUG
Sometimes the result of the third gear may not be fully presented as the predicted result, which is a temporarily unrepairable BUG.For example, the mod is predicted to be ' efficiency V Unbreaking V ', and the final result may be ' efficiency V Unbreaking IV '.
